title: Quick Filipino Celery Bistek
description: A rich and savory Filipino-inspired dish featuring crispy celery, marinated in a mixture of miso and soy sauce. Serve with steamed rice for a comforting meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the celery and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together the soy sauce, miso paste, garlic, and black pepper to make the bistek marinade.
Pour the marinade over the celery and cook, stirring occasionally, until the celery is tender and caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add the butter to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until it is melted and the celery is coated in the buttery sauce.
Season the celery with salt to taste.
Serve the celery hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
Serve with steamed rice for a comforting meal.
